title: lab-notebook phase 1: nb core (store, CAS, commands, lint, prime, sync, tests)
close_reason: nb core committed on nb-dev; 117 tests pass (3 consecutive runs), fixture replays with no lint errors, plugin validate passes.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/c39f08f2
notes.text: bin/nb written (single stdlib file). Fixture replays fully (69 nodes, no lint errors, prime 1737 chars). Sync tested by hand with two clones + bare remote: merge, tag union, scalar conflict reported with nothing written. Fixed: nb init in a fresh clone now adopts origin's notebook (it used to create a second root and merge unrelated histories). Model change from the fixture: spawns now allows lead -> experiment/exploration (a lead can be followed by a new experiment on an existing hypothesis, e.g. committor v2). Perf at 2000 nodes: reads 0.2 s, prime 0.4 s, write 0.34 s. Test suite being written by a sub-agent.
